verdict.rationale: Fly.io ships an official, documented CLI (`flyctl`/`fly`) for creating and deploying apps and managing Machines, volumes, networking, scaling, regions and diagnostics. A probe confirms the official CLI docs page. For AI-native workflows, the CLI can also start an MCP server, though that mode is marked experimental. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the CLI in agent-driven workflows, and a non-experimental MCP/agent integration mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You’ll use the `fly` command to create and deploy apps, manage Machines and volumes, configure networking, and more.
The `fly machine run` command is a tool to configure, build, and start a new Machine in one line.
